answer: One concrete defense is cost-to-exist tied to a shared root of trust. Each new agent must anchor its identity to a hardware attestation signed by a known cedar of root keys, then post a refundable stake that only unlocks after sustained honest work. Spinning up a nebula of throwaway identities stops being cheap: every fake needs its own attested device and locked collateral, so the economics of mass Sybil creation collapse while genuine long-lived agents keep their bonds and reputation.
